posts.author: B3N4ZC4L
posts.body:
I think the dialogue option is something you can work with with the help of both Switches and Variables.
depending on how many things you want the player to interact with, Self Switches might be the Key for most things. although be aware that a single Event can only hold up to 20 Event Pages but there are ways to get used to that limitation if you ever run into that Limit for some reason. As for the Dialogues itself I suggest writing it all down in a Word document first to see how much text you need in total + it's easier to copy/paste the finished dialogues into the Events once you're done writing them all down into Word.
